body.name: Square observational matching object
body.construction: For a square mechanism, let \(\mathscr R(Q)=\{[Q_{r,:}]:r\in X\}\). Construct \(\mathbb G_b(\mathscr R)\) with row-class vertices \(r\), label vertices \(i\in X\), and \((r,i)\) an edge exactly when \(r_i\ne0\). Define \(\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{obs}}(\mathscr R)=\operatorname{PM}(\mathbb G_b(\mathscr R))\).
